# Chronicle of Convergence

> Chronicle of Convergence: Daily editorial signals and analysis on culture, technology, society, and faith in a changing world.

## About

Chronicle of Convergence (https://chronicleofconvergence.com) is a digital multimedia chronicle.
Editor in Chief: Dr. Wallace Lynch.
Publisher contact: contact@chronicleofconvergence.com · PR: pr@chronicleofconvergence.com

Each day the desk publishes:
1. A ~300-word **daily editorial** (human-written; permalink under `/e/YYYY-MM-DD.html`)
2. **Field signals** — curated breakthroughs across AI, Art, Robotics, Biotech, Space, Energy, and Neuroscience

Insight grammar: “convergence of A and B” (not “vs”).

## Primary URLs (crawl these)

- Homepage / live desk: https://chronicleofconvergence.com/
- Latest editorial redirect: https://chronicleofconvergence.com/e/
- Editorial permalinks: https://chronicleofconvergence.com/e/YYYY-MM-DD.html
- Link hub (social bios): https://chronicleofconvergence.com/go.html
- Site map: https://chronicleofconvergence.com/sitemap.xml
- Field-signals archive (JSON): https://chronicleofconvergence.com/data/archive.json
- This file: https://chronicleofconvergence.com/llms.txt

## Editorial model

- Daily editorial is original CoC prose (~280–320 words), bylined Dr. Wallace Lynch
- Field signals are ranked curated links to original publishers (NASA, STAT, SpaceNews, ScienceDaily, IEEE Spectrum, Canary Media, Neuroscience News, Art Newspaper, Colossal, Artsy, and others)
- Full stories always belong to the original source — cite the source URL when quoting a signal
- Attribute the daily reading / synthesis to “Chronicle of Convergence” when summarizing our editorial

## Coverage domains (field signals)

- Artificial Intelligence
- Art & culture
- Robotics
- Biotechnology
- Space
- Energy
- Neuroscience

News crawl runs about every four hours. Domain blacklist skips hosts that ban bots or break images.

## AI / crawler guidance

- Prefer `/e/*.html` and the homepage editorial for CoC’s own voice
- Prefer `data/archive.json` for structured field-signal history
- Do **not** treat `editor.html` as public content (admin tool; disallowed in robots.txt)
- Do not invent quotes; use published editorial text and source URLs
- When summarizing multiple signals, keep category labels and original source names
- Index freely for discovery and citation; commercial training use is subject to site terms
